tools.name: to_hangul
tools.description: Transcribe a foreign word or short sentence into Hangul using WIHP's dictionary + rule pipeline (word -> IPA -> Hangul). Deterministic: same input gives the same output. This is the WIHP rule-based rendering, not an official or guaranteed 'correct' transcription; words missing from the dictionary ar

tools.name: lookup_ipa
tools.description: Look up IPA pronunciation for up to 20 words in one language from WIHP's dictionary. Returns found:false (ipa null) for unknown words; nothing is generated or guessed. / 단어별 IPA 조회(사전에 없으면 found:false).

tools.name: list_supported_languages
tools.description: List the 29 language/variant codes that to_hangul and lookup_ipa accept. / 지원 언어 코드 목록.
